newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish shares end lower on U.S. opening, Astra.
newsitem.headline: Swedish shares end lower on U.S. opening, Astra.

text.p: Swedish shares ended lower on Friday after coming off day highs on New York opening lower and a fall in drugs major Astra.
"There could also be underlying worries about the dollar," a dealer said.
The general index slipped 0.16 percent to 2,796.66 in turnover 4.63 billion crowns.

Astra dropped 3.5 crowns to 320 after reaching an intra-day high of 328 crowns. "I think the fact that (Astra) options were expiring had an effect," a dealer said. "Many holding options with 310 crowns strike took the chance to sell." Telecoms
group Ericsson rose 1.5 crowns to 269.5 after news about it expecting worldwide mobile phone sales reaching between 200 million and 300 million phones in 2000.
Fashion retailer Hennes & Mauritz slipped three crowns to 271 after coming off day highs of 285 crowns.
Steel group Avesta Sheffield slipped two crowns to 82.5 after releasing a lower than expected first quarter result a day earlier.
Automotive group Volvo rose one crown to 208.5 with options expiring.
